origin: Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-backstreet.mjs from the owner's DVYDRM wordmark master (scripts/cinema2-assets/sources/dvydrm-wordmark-master.svg): the neon sign of BACKSTREET, a glass tube of constant radius traced round each of the master's ten closed contours (outline only, as in the production reference), hung off a black painted brick wall by sixteen clear standoff clips. Three parts/materials: `tubeCores` (the lit neon; every vertex carries Mainframe's circuit attributes `_GLOW_PHASE`, `_MAINFRAME_ROUTE`, `_MAINFRAME_BANK`, `_MAINFRAME_REGION` and `_MAINFRAME_SYSTEM` so the Mainframe lighting programs drive it), `clips`, and `wall` (one large plane with an in-house tileable black-painted brick texture set: base colour, normal, metal/roughness). The sign is centred on the origin in the z = 0 plane, 8.8 units wide, facing +Z; the wall is at z = -0.3. One file serves every quality tier.
